OldaleTown_Text_SavingMyProgress: I want to take a rest, so I'm saving my progress.
OldaleTown_Text_IWorkAtPokemonMart:
Hi! I work at a POKéMON MART.
Can I get you to come with me?
OldaleTown_Text_ThisIsAPokemonMart:
This is a POKéMON MART. Just look for our blue roof.
We sell a variety of goods including POKé BALLS for catching POKéMON.
Here, I'd like you to have this as a promotional item.
OldaleTown_Text_PotionExplanation: A POTION can be used anytime, so it's even more useful than a POKéMON CENTER in certain situations.
OldaleTown_Text_WaitDontComeInHere:
Aaaaah! Wait! Please don't come in here.
I just discovered the footprints of a rare POKéMON!
Wait until I finish sketching them, okay?
OldaleTown_Text_DiscoveredFootprints:
I just discovered the footprints of a rare POKéMON!
Wait until I finish sketching them, okay?
OldaleTown_Text_FinishedSketchingFootpri:
I finished sketching the footprints of a rare POKéMON.
But it turns out they were only my own footprints…
OldaleTown_Text_MayLetsGoBack: MAY: {PLAYER}{KUN}! Over here! Let's hurry home!
OldaleTown_Text_BrendanLetsGoBack: BRENDAN: I'm heading back to my dad's LAB now. {PLAYER}, you should hustle back, too.
OldaleTown_Text_TownSign: OLDALE TOWN “Where things start off scarce.”
